title: Rules on the Collection, Management and Joint Use of Marine and Fisheries Information
title_original: 해양수산정보의 수집ㆍ관리 및 공동이용에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters concerning the collection, management and joint use of marine and fisheries information for the rational management and conservation, development and use of the sea and marine and fisheries resources and the promotion of marine fisheries, pursuant to Article 32 of the Framework Act on Marine Fishery Development and Article 23 of the Enforcement Decree of that Act.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in these Rules shall have the following meanings:
1. “Marine and fisheries information” means information concerning the rational management and conservation, development and use of the sea and marine and fisheries resources and the promotion of marine fisheries, which the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries produces, collects and manages.
2. “Marine and fisheries information joint use system” means an information system established and operated to enable the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries to collect, store, analyze, process, link and provide marine and fisheries information for the joint use of such information.

Article 3 (Comprehensive Plan for the Joint Use of Marine and Fisheries Information)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall, in accordance with the basic plan for the development of maritime affairs and fisheries under Article 6 of the Framework Act on Marine Fishery Development, formulate a comprehensive plan for the joint use of marine and fisheries information (hereinafter referred to as the “joint use plan”) every three years, following consultation with the heads of other central administrative agencies, local governments and public institutions (hereinafter referred to as “relevant institutions”).
(2) The joint use plan shall include the following matters:
1. Objectives and implementation strategies for the joint use of marine and fisheries information;
2. Matters concerning the establishment of databases of marine and fisheries information;
3. Forms and methods of joint use, including the provision of marine and fisheries information;
4. Matters concerning the scope of marine and fisheries information subject to joint use and the expansion of marine and fisheries information available for joint use;
5. Matters concerning links between information systems relating to marine and fisheries information;
6. Matters concerning the protection of marine and fisheries information;
7. Matters concerning the standardization and quality management of marine and fisheries information;
8. Matters concerning the promotion of the development of technologies for providing marine and fisheries information;
9. Matters concerning investment and financing necessary for the joint use of marine and fisheries information;
10. Other matters the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries considers necessary for the joint use of marine and fisheries information and related matters.
(3) When formulating or amending the joint use plan, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall finalize it following deliberation by the Marine and Fisheries Information Steering Committee under Article 4 and shall notify the heads of relevant institutions thereof.

Article 4 (Marine and Fisheries Information Steering Committee)
(1) The Marine and Fisheries Information Steering Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Steering Committee”) shall be established under the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries to deliberate on matters concerning the joint use of marine and fisheries information.
(2) The Steering Committee shall consist of no more than 20 members, including one chairperson.
(3) The head of the Marine Policy Office of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries shall serve as the chairperson of the Steering Committee, and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall appoint or commission its members from among the persons falling under either of the following subparagraphs, taking gender into consideration. Where the chairperson of the Steering Committee is unable to perform the duties of office due to unavoidable circumstances, a member designated by the chairperson shall perform those duties on the chairperson’s behalf.
1. Public officials of Grade 4 or higher in central administrative agencies or local governments, or persons holding equivalent positions in public institutions;
2. Persons with extensive expertise and experience in marine and fisheries information.
(4) The term of office of a member commissioned under paragraph (3) 2 shall be two years.

Article 5 (Operation of the Steering Committee)
(1) The Steering Committee shall deliberate on the following matters: <Amended on February 20, 2020>
1. Matters concerning the joint use plan;
2. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the marine and fisheries information joint use system;
3. Matters concerning the operation of the National Marine and Fisheries Information Center under Article 32 (2) of the Framework Act on Marine Fishery Development (hereinafter referred to as the “National Marine and Fisheries Information Center”);
4. Other matters the chairperson of the Steering Committee considers necessary.
(2) The chairperson of the Steering Committee shall convene its meetings. A meeting shall commence with the attendance of a majority of the incumbent members, and resolutions shall be adopted with the approval of a majority of the members present.
(3) Matters necessary for the operation of the Steering Committee, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.

Article 6 (Establishment and Operation of the Marine and Fisheries Information Joint Use System)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall establish and operate the marine and fisheries information joint use system and promote its use.
(2) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may collect marine and fisheries information for the establishment and operation of the marine and fisheries information joint use system. In such cases, the Minister may request the heads of institutions that produce and manage information concerning maritime affairs and fisheries to provide such information and related assistance pursuant to Article 23 (3) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Marine Fishery Development.
(3) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall organize and manage the information collected under paragraph (2) in databases or electronic files, and shall take measures necessary for the operation of the marine and fisheries information joint use system, including the development of various information services.

Article 7 (Guidelines for the Joint Use of Marine and Fisheries Information)
(1) To ensure the efficient operation of the marine and fisheries information joint use system, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may prepare guidelines for the joint use of marine and fisheries information in consultation with the heads of relevant institutions.
(2) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries prepares guidelines for the joint use of marine and fisheries information under paragraph (1), the Minister shall notify the heads of relevant institutions and publicly notify the guidelines.

Article 8 (Provision of Marine and Fisheries Information)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall provide users with the marine and fisheries information collected and managed in the marine and fisheries information joint use system; provided that this shall not apply where other statutes or regulations restrict the provision of such information.
(2) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall manage the marine and fisheries information under paragraph (1) so that its currency, accuracy and interconnectivity can be maintained.
(3) To promote the joint use of marine and fisheries information, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may provide users with information obtained by analyzing or processing marine and fisheries information.
(4) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall manage a list of the marine and fisheries information provided under paragraphs (1) and (3).
(5) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall publicly announce the list of marine and fisheries information under paragraph (4) through the marine and fisheries information joint use system. The same shall apply where the list is amended.

Article 9 (Monitoring of the Use of Marine and Fisheries Information)
To promote the joint use of marine and fisheries information, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may monitor and manage the state of use and difficulties experienced by users of the marine and fisheries information joint use system.

Article 10 (Protection of Marine and Fisheries Information)
The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall formulate and implement information protection measures necessary to prevent improper access to or use of marine and fisheries information, or its forgery, alteration, damage or disclosure.

Article 11 (Quality Management of Marine and Fisheries Information)
(1) To ensure the appropriate quality of marine and fisheries information, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall conduct a diagnosis and evaluation of the quality of such information each year.
(2) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intends to conduct a diagnosis and evaluation of the quality of marine and fisheries information under paragraph (1), the Minister shall formulate a quality diagnosis and evaluation plan that includes the following matters:
1. The marine and fisheries information subject to quality diagnosis and evaluation;
2. The implementation framework for the quality diagnosis and evaluation;
3. The procedures and period for the quality diagnosis and evaluation;
4. Improvement measures to be taken based on the results of the quality diagnosis and evaluation;
5. The criteria for the quality diagnosis and evaluation.
(3) Where the results of the quality diagnosis and evaluation under paragraph (1) indicate that marine and fisheries information requires improvement, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall rectify it.

Article 12 (Standardization of Marine and Fisheries Information)
To promote the joint use of marine and fisheries information and manage such information efficiently, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall establish and implement standards on the following matters; provided that this shall not apply where standards officially recognized at the national level under the Framework Act on National Standards, the Industrial Standardization Act or other relevant statutes, or otherwise officially recognized internationally, exist:
1. The forms and technologies for providing marine and fisheries information;
2. The classification system for providing marine and fisheries information;
3. Other matters the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries considers necessary to promote the joint use of marine and fisheries information.

Article 13 (Establishment and Operation of the National Marine and Fisheries Information Center)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall establish the National Marine and Fisheries Information Center within the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries pursuant to Article 32 (2) of the Framework Act on Marine Fishery Development.
(2) The head of the Marine Policy Office of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries shall serve as the head of the National Marine and Fisheries Information Center.
(3) Other details necessary for the establishment and operation of the National Marine and Fisheries Information Center shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.

Addendum <Ordinance No. 260, September 29, 2017>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Addendum <Ordinance No. 388, February 20, 2020>
These Rules shall enter into force on February 21, 2020.
